front: What is ecommerce platform architecture in one sentence?
back: Reference microservice architecture for a multi-vendor e-commerce backend (Go/Node, Postgres/Mongo/Redis, Kafka, EKS) — staff design review baseline, not a product backlog.

front: Explain the mental model of ecommerce platform architecture (how the system thinks).
back: Money and catalog are separate failure domains. Never hold catalog locks while waiting on PSP. Emit facts after local commit (outbox), consume with idempotent handlers.

front: Symptom: Paid in PSP, order pending — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Payment outbox lag; webhook idempotency · Fix: Replay outbox; reconcile job; marketplace app webhook table

front: Symptom: Double charge — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Idempotency-Key on intent API · Fix: Redis + PG unique on key

front: Symptom: Refund stuck — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Refund saga step, PSP dashboard · Fix: Retry RefundIssued; DLQ inspection

front: Symptom: Flash sale oversell — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Redis promo counter vs PG · Fix: Lower TTL holds; partition Kafka by campaign

front: Symptom: Stale prices at checkout — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Pricing cache vs gRPC path · Fix: Short TTL; PriceChanged fan-out

front: Symptom: Notification storm — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Consumer lag, provider throttle · Fix: Scale notification workers; per-user rate limit

front: Gotcha with ecommerce platform architecture: what silently fails?
back: Saga in Kafka consumers without idempotency — every handler keys on event.id or business idempotency key.

front: When should you NOT use ecommerce platform architecture?
back: Single-merchant Shopify-scale store — modular monolith + marketplace app subset. < 100 RPS — eight services + Kafka is operability overhead; start monolith with outbox table. Strong cross-entity ACID — use monolith DB or redesign aggregates; not 2PC across services.

front: What is marketplace app in one sentence?
back: Two-sided marketplace architecture: payments, trust, inventory, and dispute boundaries — design checklist for staff reviews, not a build backlog.

front: Explain the mental model of marketplace app (how the system thinks).
back: Hard problems are orthogonal to CRUD: Double sale of last unit (inventory concurrency) Payment success, order create fail (distributed transaction) Seller payout vs chargeback window (ledger timing) Search ranking gaming (trust/abuse)

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for marketplace app?
back: Design for eventual consistency with explicit user-visible states — not one giant ACID transaction across Stripe + Postgres + search index. → Persist transitions with actor, reason, idempotency key — support will replay history.

front: Given a broken marketplace app setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Design for eventual consistency with explicit user-visible states — not one giant ACID transaction across Stripe + Postgres + search index.

front: What are the production-safe defaults for marketplace app?
back: Persist transitions with actor, reason, idempotency key — support will replay history.

front: Symptom: Oversold SKU — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Reservation TTL, race logs · Fix: Pessimistic lock hot SKUs; extend hold on payment step

front: Symptom: Paid order missing — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Webhook 5xx / no idempotency · Fix: Replay webhooks; dead-letter queue; reconcile job

front: Symptom: Seller not paid — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Payout batch / KYC hold · Fix: Ledger report; manual adjustment with audit

front: Symptom: Duplicate charges — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Client double-submit · Fix: Idempotency-Key header on checkout API

front: Symptom: Review bombing — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Velocity by IP/account age · Fix: Rate limits; verified purchase only

front: Symptom: Search shows delisted item — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Index lag · Fix: Tombstone events; periodic full reindex

front: Symptom: Tax wrong jurisdiction — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Address vs IP vs nexus rules · Fix: Tax engine vendor; don't hand-roll VAT

front: Gotcha with marketplace app: what silently fails?
back: Treat PSP balance as source of truth for cash — app ledger reconciles to Stripe daily; drift happens.

front: When should you NOT use marketplace app?
back: Single merchant store — Shopify/WooCommerce; skip two-sided payout complexity. Classifieds (no payment on platform) — trust/messaging only; narrower scope. Real-time auction without ops — sniping, shill bidding need dedicated fraud team.
